lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur deen daiaal jis sa(n)g har gaaveeai jeeu ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is merciful to the meek; in His Presence, the Lord's Praises are sung.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam saadhasa(n)g raaveeai jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is chanted in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧੂ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaj sa(n)g saadhoo ik araadhoo janam maran dukh naasae ||
lines.translation: Vibrating, and worshipping the One Lord in the Company of the Holy, the pains of birth and death are removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਿਖਿਆ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur karam likhiaa saach sikhiaa katee jam kee phaasae ||
lines.translation: Those who have such karma pre-ordained, study and learn the Truth; the noose of Death is removed from their necks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਨਾਠੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਗਾਠੇ ਜਮ ਪੰਥਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bharam naathe chhutee gaathe jam pa(n)th mool na aaveeai ||
lines.translation: Their fears and doubts are dispelled, the knot of death is untied, and they never have to walk on Death's path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa sadaa har gun gaaveeai ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; let me sing Your Glorious Praises forever. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nidhariaa dhar ek naam nira(n)jano jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Name of the One, Immaculate Lord is the Support of the unsupported.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too daataa daataar sarab dukh bha(n)jano jeeu ||
lines.translation: You are the Giver, the Great Giver, the Dispeller of all sorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh harat karataa sukhah suaamee saran saadhoo aaiaa ||
lines.translation: O Destroyer of pain, Creator Lord, Master of peace and bliss, I have come seeking the Sanctuary of the Holy;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਪਲ ਏਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar mahaa bikhaRaa pal ek maahi taraaiaa ||
lines.translation: please, help me to cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਜਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: poor rahiaa sarab thaaee gur giaan netree a(n)jano ||
lines.translation: I saw the Lord pervading and permeating everywhere, when the healing ointment of the Guru's wisdom was applied to my eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa simaree sarab dukh bhai bha(n)jano ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, remember Him forever in meditation, the Destroyer of all sorrow and fear. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap leee laR laai kirapaa dhaareeaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe; He has showered me with His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi niragun neech anaath prabh agam apaareeaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: I am worthless, lowly and helpless; God is unfathomable and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੀਚ ਥਾਪਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaal sadaa kripaal suaamee neech thaapanahaariaa ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is always merciful, kind and compassionate; He uplifts and establishes the lowly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh vas terai sagal teree saariaa ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures are under Your power; You take care of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap sagal beechaareeaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself is the Contemplator of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak gun gaai jeevaa har jap japau banavaareeaa ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, singing Your Glorious Praises, I live, chanting the Chant of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa daras apaar naam amolaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is incomparable; Your Name is utterly priceless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਤੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit japahi tere daas purakh atolaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: O my Incomputable Lord, Your humble servants ever meditate on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਵੂਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਮਾਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t rasan voothaa aap toothaa har rasahi seee maatiaa ||
lines.translation: You dwell on the tongues of the Saints, by Your own pleasure; they are intoxicated with Your sublime essence, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਹਾ ਭਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur charan laage mahaa bhaage sadaa anadin jaagiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are attached to Your feet are very blessed; night and day, they remain always awake and aware.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਬੵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sad sadaa si(n)mrataby suaamee saas saas gun bolaee ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master; with each and every breath, speak His Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਮੋਲਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhoor saadhoo naam prabhoo amolaee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, let me become the dust of the feet of the Saints. God's Name is invaluable. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag dhanaasaree baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: sanak sana(n)d mahes samaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Beings like Sanak, Sanand, Shiva and Shaysh-naaga

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖਨਾਗਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sekhanaag tero maram na jaanaa(n) ||1||
lines.translation: - none of them know Your mystery, Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat raam ridai basaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells within the heart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਨੂਮਾਨ ਸਰਿ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: hanoomaan sar garuR samaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Beings like Hanumaan, Garura, Indra the King of the gods and the rulers of humans

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: surapat narapat nahee gun jaanaa(n) ||2||
lines.translation: - none of them know Your Glories, Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaar bed ar si(n)mrit puraanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: The four Vedas, the Simritees and the Puraanas, Vishnu the Lord of Lakshmi

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਮਲਾਪਤਿ ਕਵਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kamalaapat kavalaa nahee jaanaa(n) ||3||
lines.translation: And Lakshmi herself - none of them know the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋ ਭਰਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer so bharamai naahee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, one who falls at the Lord's feet,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਨਾਂਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pag lag raam rahai saranaa(n)hee ||4||1||
lines.translation: And remains in His Sanctuary, does not wander around lost. ||4||1||
